title: Minigame: A11.5 CC vs a vehicle, the CCV

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the minigame of the A11.5 claim (the Rules-first plan, section 7): German Infantry, one a designated Assault Engineer, attack a Russian T-34 in CC, their facts entered by hand.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): the attackers' CCV and what a Final DR does to the vehicle, asked on the Rule Workbench.
The German 8-3-8 is an Assault Engineer by designation (H1.22, A25.12): the catalog's counters carry no DC symbol today.

introduction: A11.5's example: the German 9-2 and 4-6-7 attack the T-34 in [F4] with a CCV of 6; beside them an Assault Engineer 8-3-8, a pinned 5-4-8, and an Unarmed squad.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
